ValidationRule.description:
Automated Onboarding Email field is required when Opp record Stage field = Approve
Case/Ticket: #00016004
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( TEXT(Automated_Onboarding_Email__c) = NULL, ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Approve'),
RecordType.DeveloperName != 'True_Up', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal')),
Service_Offering_Rollup__c != 'Product', Service_Offering_Rollup__c != 'License Subscription', Service_Offering_Rollup__c != '',
NOT(CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Salesforce')), NOT(CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'HubSpot')), NOT(CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Zingly')), NOT(CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Application Solutions')),
NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules), NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6'), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'SAS_Sales_Team') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Automated Onboarding Email" field is required when the Opportunity record's Stage field = "Approve"
